a:r.a:t: Here are the resources to get started.
The Rift GitHub repository has full documentation, examples, and compatibility information. The Docker image is publicly available - you can try it today.

There's a detailed compatibility matrix that documents exactly which Mountebank features are supported. And the project has 126 automated tests that verify compatibility by running the same scenarios against both Mountebank and Rift.
If you want to try Rift for your team, start with your existing imposter configs. If something doesn't work, file a GitHub issue. The project is actively maintained and responsive to feedback.
I'm happy to help teams evaluate Rift for their use cases. Reach out on Slack in the test-automation channel.
